constraints: Sample real test queries before retrieval or model execution; do not condition inclusion on answer quality or sentinel exposure
Include the selected queries' positive qrel documents in a fixed 3000-document corpus; fill remaining slots by seeded random sampling
Use the same ordinary documents and the same 30 sentinel identities for both injection methods
Retain ordinary texts verbatim and keep sentinels as independent documents; no watermark-aware target prompts
Use the existing answer_with_rag prompt for all target conditions
Reuse target completions only for exactly identical model settings and prompts; disclose logical outputs versus physical API requests
Make independent clean-repeat requests in a separate cache namespace to estimate intrinsic answer variation
Blind method labels and randomize answer order for the semantic and reference-grounded quality judge
Report answer interference, quality deterioration, paired quality differences, abstention, and retrieval changes separately
LLM quality ratings are surrogate judgments, not human annotations or gold answer accuracy
Preserve failed or malformed attempts; never count incomplete model responses as successful utility observations
